const id = Symbol("id");
const user = { [id]: 7, name: "a" };
console.log(user[id], user);
user[id] = 8;
console.log(user[id] + 1);
const step = Symbol("step");
class Counter {
  static readonly kind = Symbol("kind");
  [id] = 1;
  [step]() {
    return this[id] * 2;
  }
}
const counter = new Counter();
console.log(counter[id], counter[step](), typeof Counter.kind);
interface Labeled {
  [id]: number;
  label: string;
}
const labeled: Labeled = { [id]: 3, label: "x" };
console.log(labeled[id]);
let copy = id;
copy = Symbol("next");
const key: symbol = id;
console.log(typeof key, copy.toString(), id.description);
const registered = Symbol.for("shared");
const shared = { [registered]: true };
console.log(shared[registered], Symbol.for("shared") === registered);
const spread = { ...user, extra: 1 };
console.log(spread[id], Object.keys(spread));
